comment: The new-runtime gap table (#2256). This file is the only copy: #2256 links here. Each row is a gap between OpenTofu's new runtime (internal/engine) and what choudoufu needs, how it is handled while TOFU_X_EXPERIMENTAL_RUNTIME is on, and what closes it. check is one of: live (G's refusal, #2339), preflight (refused on the configuration or state before planning), post_plan (refused on the plan before it is shown or saved), engine (a diagnostic raised inside planning), accepted (not refused; named in the toggle's warning), none. Preflight and post-plan rows also run on apply PLANFILE with the toggle on. A row filled by a fork port (#2376) names its package in fork_port and the switch that turns it off in switch, and its upstream list is what expires the port; internal/engine/forkport registers the port with the same rows and issues, and CHOUDOUFU_NEW_RUNTIME_NO_FORK_PORTS=1 turns every port off. Upstream issues and PRs are written as `#NNNN` and are opentofu/opentofu's.

rows.gap: any live mode on the new runtime
rows.interim: refused where NewRuntimeEnabled() is checked (TOFU_X_EXPERIMENTAL_RUNTIME_NEXT, #2339); the check where the runtime is chosen (any ConfigValueAdjuster set) was lifted by U6 (#2342), so live mode runs on the new runtime under TOFU_X_EXPERIMENTAL_RUNTIME
rows.closed_by: U6 (#2342) lifted the first check; the second stays until upstream calls _NEXT stable

rows.interim: none needed: ported by U4 (#2340)

rows.gap: markers and records at apply time
rows.interim: none needed: ported by U5 (#2341)
none needed: ported by U6 (#2342); the resolver's target becomes an import statement in the planning engine

rows.gap: markers on the create half of a replace
rows.interim: none needed: U7 (#2343) ported it; the create half of a replace is planned and final-planned through the create entry point in both orderings, and live mode no longer refuses a replace

rows.gap: cycle on a replace with newly enabled create_before_destroy
rows.interim: refuse replace actions outside live mode, so a plan cannot half-apply. Live mode does not refuse a replace since U7 (#2343)
ported by U8 (#2344): the new runtime's planning engine writes the configured destroy-time arguments into the delete's prior state, and its apply engine sends them from the plan
refuse data blocks, except what the in-run-estates fork port covers while it is on

rows.gap: in-run estates and the terraform_estate_outputs data source
rows.interim: a fork port (#2370), not upstream's code: a data "terraform_estate_outputs" block of the builtin terraform provider plans on the new runtime. One naming an estate the run applies as a module is answered from that module's outputs and deferred to the apply while the module has changes pending; any other is read from the record store during the plan. Every other data block stays refused by the data-sources row. With the switch set the port is off and the data-sources row refuses these blocks again
rows.closed_by: removed, package and call sites and this row, when upstream's data-resource support lands

rows.interim: refuse removed blocks

rows.gap: moved blocks (not yet treated as active)
rows.interim: none needed: verified for #2378 that upstream's new runtime executes moved blocks (internal/engine/planning/plan_moved.go), including the old runtime's "Moved resource instances excluded by targeting" error under -target and -exclude; the old runtime's moved tests pass on it. A moved block next to a removed block is still refused, by the removed row. Live mode resolves moved blocks by marker instead: see moved-live
rows.closed_by: #2378, verified, no fork port; upstream's moved and removed work stays tracked

rows.gap: moved blocks in live mode that an ownership marker cannot follow
rows.interim: U10 (#2374): live mode resolves a moved block by marker before the engine runs. Discovery binds the object still carrying the old tofu-address to the new address, the projected prior state already holds it there, and the move finishes as an in-place tag update, so the engine never executes a move and ignores the statement, whose old address has no state entry. That holds for the shapes internal/live/moved's Honourable admits, which are the ones internal/live/lint admits and discovery aliases; every other moved block is refused here, as lint refuses it on either runtime
rows.closed_by: a moved block whose endpoints an ownership marker can follow, or choudoufu live-mv, which rewrites the marker directly

rows.interim: refuse validation blocks on variables

rows.gap: upgrade of orphaned or deposed objects
rows.interim: none needed: verified for #2378 that upstream's new runtime upgrades, refreshes and deletes deposed objects (internal/engine/planning/plan_managed.go, planUnwantedManagedResourceInstanceObject; apply's ManagedDeposedMeta and ManagedAlreadyDeposed); the old runtime's deposed tests pass on it. lifecycle destroy = false recorded on a deposed object is still refused, by the lifecycle-destroy row
